zh-CN.title: 更连贯的课题与任务体验
items: 桌面子窗口浮动打开，保留当前课题面板
课题与任务统一为进行中、已存档，列表无需切换筛选
任务进度复用广场评论布局，支持 Markdown 与分层回复

en.title: A smoother project and task experience
items: Nested desktop drawers float above the current project
Projects and tasks use Active and Archived states without filter tabs
Task progress shares Square comment layouts with Markdown and threaded replies
